outgoing.name: Great Britain
outgoing.excerpt: It is a very rare breeder in Great Britain and Ireland, but winters in large numbers in these countries.

outgoing.name: Old English language
outgoing.excerpt: Its name derives from the Anglo-Saxon feld-fere meaning traveller through the fields, probably named so for their constantly moving, foraging habits.
